summary: As of the cutoff date 2026-10-01, Warren Buffett is no longer the CEO of Berkshire Hathaway; he stepped down in late 2025/early 2026 and became chairman emeritus while remaining a director. Greg Abel assumed the CEO role on or before January 1 2026 and is the current CEO. This conclusion is supported by multiple news outlets and a Wikipedia entry, yielding a FALSE verdict with 96% confidence.

findings.statement: Warren Buffett is not the CEO of Berkshire Hathaway as of the cutoff date 2026-10-01.
Greg Abel is the CEO of Berkshire Hathaway as of the cutoff date 2026-10-01.
